FAQ’S
Important Information
What are the reception desk hours?
Our reception team can be reached daily from 8:00 am to 20:00 pm under the telephone number +39-0471-636000.
Should I take my room key with me when I go somewhere?
When you leave the hotel, please ALWAYS take your room key with you. The large, wrought-iron gate at the entrance is closed in the evening. As a guest, you can open it with the key card. At later hours, the other entrances of the hotel are also locked.
When can I check in to my room?
Check-in is from 2:30 to 7:30 pm. You can of course arrive earlier and enjoy our pools and the wellness area. For an arrival after 8:00 pm we ask you to contact us by phone.
How long can I stay in the room on my departure day?
We ask that you check out of your room by 11:00 am. A late check-out is possible if available. Please contact the reception desk for more information. In the afternoon, you can of course enjoy the relaxing pool area.
How can I pay the hotel bill?
We accept EC cards, VISA, MasterCard, American Express and cash up to max. Euro 4.999,99 per person.
How do I get the daily newspaper?
We are happy to provide you with your desired paper at breakfast. Please place your order the day before at the reception desk.
Where can I park my car?
Around the castle, there are plenty of parking spaces available. If you would like to park your car in the locked garage, you can book a space for 15 per day.
Is there Internet in the hotel?
Schloss Hotel Korb provides free WIFI connection. Select the network "Korb". If you have any problems, contact us at the reception desk.
What time is breakfast?
Our lavish breakfast buffet awaits you from 7:30 to 10:30 am. If you prefer a later breakfast, we will be happy to serve you whenever you like!
When is lunch and dinner?
For our hotel guests, dinner is served from 7:00 PM to 8:30 PM.
For external guests, our gourmet restaurant Aurum is open from Thursday to Monday, from 12:00 PM to 2:00 PM and from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM.
How and when can I use the wellness facilities?
The outdoor and indoor pool are open daily from 8:00 am to 8:00 pm. The sauna and steam bath can be turned on anytime upon request and ready and warm in 30 min.
Is the tennis court and the gym available for free?
Yes, our tennis court is available to hotel guests for free. If you would like to play at a certain time, simply reserve a court at the reception desk. Tennis rackets and balls are also available.
Also, the Gym is for free. You can enter whenever you like.
What kind of recreational opportunities are there?
Cycling, hiking, golfing, events, concerts, exhibits - our region offers numerous opportunities for a variety of recreational activities. In the entrance area of the castle residence, there is an information table. For romantic hours, we will be happy to organize a picnic in our vineyards. Detailed information for all recreational opportunities is available at the reception desk.
Where is the nearest pharmacy?
Only 4 min. away by car from the castle directly in San Paolo. The reception staff will inform you of pharmacy hours for Sundays and holidays.
Am I allowed to bring my dog?
Your dog is a valued guest at Schloss Hotel Korb and is always very welcome.
Four-legged guests are welcome to accompany you for breakfast and dinner, provided they remain quietly under the table. To ensure that you can enjoy a wonderful holiday together, our garden and pool area also includes a designated space where dogs can relax and enjoy their time.
For your four-legged companion, we charge 25.00 per day, excluding food.
Even if we have the luck to have wonderful dog owners as our guests, the following advice is helpful for good organization: At the end of the tennis court is a dog waste disposal area. We ask to make use of. Thank you for your comprehension!
